description: A correction to an existing record. Confirming an overwrite is the same yes-or-no shape as confirming a new record, and must offer the same buttons — this is the case that catches a model that learned the sentinel for one phrasing only. The second agreement is not the target shape: update_formulation's read-before-write gate refuses the first attempt and qwen2.5:32b answers the practitioner before going back to read the record, so they are asked twice. Drop that turn when a model reads first.
turns: On FM-00001, change the dosage. It is one cup at night only, not twice a day.
